title: The Over limit badge shows on the over-limit customer's work order and part sale
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 30, has a credit limit of $500.00, unpaid invoices totalling $600.00, an open work order {Work-order-1} and an open part sale {Part-sale-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-02 Customer, {Work-order-1} is S2-15440 and {Part-sale-A} is P-1345.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "Over limit" badge shows.
  • Step 2: the "Over limit" badge shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R2: “The "Over limit" badge on work orders and part sales follows the same rule as S9-R1.”
  • S9-R4: “Opening a part sale shows no over-credit confirmation, as today; for part sales only the 'Over limit' badge follows S9-R1.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "9 Invoice due date" ("An invoice today (Net 30)"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p9-01-an-invoice-today-net-30.png

The design's own words:

  • “Part sales show no over-credit confirmation (S9-R4); for part sales only the "Over limit" badge follows this rule.”
